the_four_harness_defects_that_made_earli: BUDGET FEASIBILITY. The product reserves ATOM_REPLY_LEG_MIN_SECONDS (default 40) for the answer and refuses to START a pre-reply leg it cannot pay for, so any budget <= 40s skips the canvas-edit leg entirely - no edit, no fork, and the edit planner is never called, which is also why the shim log was empty. The harness had been asking for 25s. It now refuses such a budget up front.

STALL GATED ON PROMPT TEXT. The shim matched on the substring 'canvaseditplan' across the whole message blob, and the REPLY leg's prompt contains it too, so the reply leg drew the 40s stall and starved the edit leg. Now armed for one exact tool advertised in tools[], one gated match consumes it, non-matching requests recorded separately.

SUBSCRIPTION OPENED AFTER EXECUTION. The websocket subscription was opened after the interactive reply returned, but the continuation completes seconds after the fork - before that reply - so the broadcast could never be seen. Now subscribed first, with the request issued on its own thread.

INJECTION NEVER PROVEN. 'Provider loaded' and 'no fallback marker' do not prove a request occurred. The harness now traces provider selection -> attempted request -> shim receipt -> served response -> parser acceptance, and an unproven injection yields INCONCLUSIVE.
